question.nlq: Show the names of the three customers with the highest total order value, together with each customer's total order value and their rank based on that value.

meanings.gt_sql:
WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_name,
        SUM(p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS REAL)) AS total_order_value
    FROM "Customers" c
    JOIN "Customer_Orders" co ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id
    JOIN "Order_Items" oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN "Products" p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_name
)
SELECT
    customer_name,
    total_order_value,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_order_value DESC) AS rank
FROM customer_totals
ORDER BY rank
LIMIT 3;

question.nlq: I would like to know, for each customer, the three highest‑priced products that the customer has ever ordered, together with the most recent order date on which each of those products was purchased.

meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT customer_name,
       product_name,
       product_price,
       recent_order_date
FROM (
    SELECT c.customer_name,
           p.product_name,
           p.product_price,
           MAX(co.order_date) AS recent_order_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.customer_id ORDER BY p.product_price DESC) AS rn
    FROM Customers c
    JOIN Customer_Orders co ON co.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_id = co.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name, p.product_id, p.product_name, p.product_price
) t
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY customer_name, rn;

question.nlq: What is the total quantity of items purchased for each product type across all completed orders, listed in descending order by total quantity?

    SUM(CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS total_quantity
FROM Order_Items oi
JOIN Customer_Orders co ON oi.order_id = co.order_id
JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE co.order_status_code = 'Completed'
GROUP BY p.product_type_code
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC

question.nlq: Please list, for each product_type_code, the three customers with the greatest total expenditure on orders whose order_status_code is 'Completed'. For each of these customers, also return the cumulative amount they have spent on completed orders, ordered by the order_date of the orders.

meanings.gt_sql:
WITH spent AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_type_code,
        c.customer_id,
        c.customer_name,
        SUM(p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS REAL)) AS total_spent,
        MIN(o.order_date) AS first_order_date
    FROM Order_Items oi
    JOIN Customer_Orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status_code = 'Completed'
    GROUP BY p.product_type_code, c.customer_id
)
SELECT product_type_code, customer_name, total_spent
FROM (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_type_code ORDER BY total_spent DESC) AS rn
    FROM spent
) t
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY product_type_code, first_order_date;

turns.sql:
WITH CompletedOrders AS (
    SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date
    FROM Customer_Orders
    WHERE order_status_code = 'Completed'
),
ItemAgg AS (
    SELECT co.customer_id,
           p.product_type_code,
           SUM(p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS REAL)) AS total_spent,
           MAX(co.order_date) AS last_order_date
    FROM CompletedOrders co
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_id = co.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY co.customer_id, p.product_type_code
),
Ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_type_code ORDER BY total_spent DESC) AS rn
    FROM ItemAgg
)
SELECT r.product_type_code,
       c.customer_id,
       c.customer_name,
       r.total_spent,
       r.last_order_date
FROM Ranked r
JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id
WHERE r.rn <= 3
ORDER BY r.product_type_code, r.last_order_date;
